item.title: Kalshi chief executive defends prediction market integrity on insider trading at DC Fintech Week — Oct 14, 2026 · 9:30 PM ET
item.description: - **Kalshi chief executive defends prediction market integrity on insider trading at DC Fintech Week** — At DC Fintech Week on October 14, Kalshi chief executive Tarek Mansour said illicit trading on prediction markets amounts to a crime in broad daylight because anomalies can be detected within minutes. He cited the platform lifetime ban of former congressman George Santos and a settlement involving a White House teleprompter operator as enforcement examples. ([Crypto Economy](https://crypto-economy.com/crime-in-broad-daylight-kalshi-ceo-addresses-insider-trading-risks-in-prediction-markets/))

item.title: Macquarie forecast puts 2026 prediction market taker volume on track for 187 billion dollars — Oct 14, 2026 · 9:30 PM ET
item.description: - **Macquarie forecast puts 2026 prediction market taker volume on track for 187 billion dollars** — Sigma reported Macquarie expects prediction market taker volume to reach about 187 billion dollars in 2026, after total volume hit 20.1 billion dollars in September, up 1,079 percent year on year. Sports event contracts accounted for 79 percent of September volume on the largest prediction market in the analysis. ([Sigma](https://sigma.world/news/prediction-market-volume-187b-2026-report/))

item.title: S&P Global survey finds 70 percent of prediction market users traded sports contracts — Oct 14, 2026 · 9:30 PM ET
item.description: - **S&P Global survey finds 70 percent of prediction market users traded sports contracts** — S&P Global's third quarter 2026 consumer survey found 70 percent of prediction market users traded sports contracts, ahead of 36 percent for financial outcomes and 33 percent for political outcomes. item.title: Novig launches nationwide sports prediction market after CFTC contract market approval — Oct 14, 2026 · 9:00 PM ET
item.description: - **Novig launches nationwide sports prediction market after CFTC contract market approval** — Novig said its sports prediction market is launching nationwide after CFTC approval as a designated contract market, putting it under federal oversight instead of state by state sportsbook licensing. The company said the launch adds instant live trading, more payment methods and expanded compliance and surveillance controls, with users required to be at least 21. ([DeviceDaily](https://www.devicedaily.com/?p=437872))

item.description: - **Kalshi faces conflicting claims over Oklahoma tribal partnership** — Competing factions within the Alabama-Quassarte Tribal Town have taken opposing positions on the announced PokkeTrades partnership with Kalshi, according to reporting on the dispute. item.title: Ohio orders 10 prediction markets and brokers to stop sports contracts — Oct 14, 2026 · 8:45 PM ET
item.description: - **Ohio orders 10 prediction markets and brokers to stop sports contracts** — The Ohio Casino Control Commission sent cease-and-desist letters dated October 2 to 10 operators and brokers, including Polymarket, Coinbase, Robinhood, Webull and Novig, ordering them to stop offering sports event contracts to Ohio residents. Each recipient must confirm compliance in writing within 14 days, a deadline falling on October 16, following the Sixth Circuit ruling that Ohio can enforce its gambling laws against the contracts. item.description: - **Torres insider trading bill draws more than 30 House backers** — Representative Ritchie Torres has formally introduced the Public Integrity in Financial Prediction Markets Act of 2026, backed by more than 30 Democratic lawmakers including former Speaker Nancy Pelosi. item.title: Senators back Prediction Markets Security and Integrity Act in new federal safety push — Oct 14, 2026 · 6:30 PM ET
item.description: - **Senators back Prediction Markets Security and Integrity Act in new federal safety push** — The bill tracked as S.4060 would bar prediction-market contracts tied to war, death or military conflict, require insider-trading and manipulation safeguards, and shift day-to-day oversight of platforms away from the CFTC toward individual states. Lawmakers paired the push with the SAFE Bet Act on sportsbook deposit limits and affordability checks. ([ReadWrite](https://readwrite.com/prediction-markets-safety-push/))

item.title: Senators introduce Public Integrity Act as second bill targeting prediction market insider trading — Oct 14, 2026 · 6:15 PM ET
item.description: - **Senators introduce Public Integrity Act as second bill targeting prediction market insider trading** — A bipartisan Senate bill from Todd Young, Elissa Slotkin, John Curtis and Adam Schiff would bar officials from trading on non-public information and require disclosure of contracts, prices, timestamps, platforms and profit or loss. It follows the House PREDICT Act and targets platforms including Kalshi and Polymarket. ([CryptoNews](https://cryptonews.com/news/second-bill-prediction-market-insider-trading/))

item.title: Connecticut judge rules CFTC cannot override court reading of federal law in Kalshi case — Oct 14, 2026 · 4:15 PM ET
item.description: - **Connecticut judge rules CFTC cannot override court reading of federal law in Kalshi case** — U.S. District Judge Vernon Oliver ruled the CFTC lacks authority to override the court interpretation of federal law in the Connecticut prediction markets case, finding its August 11 market emergency order did not change his earlier analysis. The ruling follows his denial of Kalshi request for a preliminary injunction, after he found its sports-event contracts do not qualify as swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act. ([GambleRss](https://gamblerss.com/connecticut-judge-says-cftc-cannot-override-court-s-reading-of-federal-law-in-prediction-markets-case-67760))

item.title: Wisconsin judge denies CFTC bid to block state prediction market enforcement — Oct 14, 2026 · 4:15 PM ET
item.description: - **Wisconsin judge denies CFTC bid to block state prediction market enforcement** — U.S. District Judge William Griesbach ruled the CFTC did not show irreparable harm or a likelihood of success in its suit against Wisconsin officials, so the state can keep pursuing its cases against platforms including Coinbase, Crypto.com, Kalshi and Polymarket. The CFTC had argued Wisconsin was criminalizing federally regulated markets beyond its powers. ([SBC Americas](https://sbcamericas.com/2026/07/29/wisconsin-judge-denies-cftc-injunction/))

item.description: - **Researchers question parts of Kalshi and Polymarket perpetual futures volume as platforms deny wash trading** — A working paper by Ulm University finance professor Andre Guettler argues a material share of reported perpetual futures volume on the platforms may be manufactured, which would overstate the demand behind their valuations. item.title: Ohio orders 10 prediction market operators to stop sports contracts — Oct 14, 2026 · 2:00 PM ET
item.description: - **Ohio orders 10 prediction market operators to stop sports contracts** — The Ohio Casino Control Commission told Polymarket, Robinhood, Coinbase and seven other platforms to stop offering sports event contracts to Ohioans and confirm in writing within 14 days. item.title: CFTC moves to rewrite swap rules to cover prediction market event contracts — Oct 14, 2026 · 1:45 PM ET
item.description: - **CFTC moves to rewrite swap rules to cover prediction market event contracts** — The CFTC has proposed rules that would codify sports, political, cultural and weather event contracts as federally regulated swaps, while carving conventional casino-style gambling products out of that definition. The agency says the change would clarify that event contracts fall within its exclusive jurisdiction under the Commodity Exchange Act. ([CoinSpectator](https://coinspectator.com/mainstream/2026/10/10/why-the-cftc-is-rewriting-swap-rules-for-prediction-markets-and-how-it-shifts-the-balance-of-power/))

item.title: Polymarket bank-failure bets draw UK scrutiny over market integrity risks — Oct 14, 2026 · 1:30 PM ET
item.description: - **Polymarket bank-failure bets draw UK scrutiny over market integrity risks** — Bets on Polymarket's offshore platform on whether major global banks will fail have drawn scrutiny in the United Kingdom, where the Financial Conduct Authority has said the financial prediction products it examined function similarly to binary options, banned for British retail consumers since 2019. The FCA is discussing prediction markets with overseas regulators and the Bank of England is also monitoring developments. ([Casino.org](https://www.casino.org/news/polymarket-bank-failure-bets-spark-fears-of-self-fulfilling-bank-runs/))

item.description: - **Robinhood prediction markets generate 156 million dollars in second-quarter revenue, passing crypto** — Robinhood's event contracts generated about 156 million dollars of revenue in the quarter ended June 30, more than ten times the year-earlier figure and ahead of crypto transaction revenue of about 100 million dollars. item.title: Kalshi CEO says state-led oversight of prediction markets would push firms offshore — Oct 14, 2026 · 1:00 PM ET
item.description: - **Kalshi CEO says state-led oversight of prediction markets would push firms offshore** — Kalshi CEO Tarek Mansour said on October 14 that if U.S. courts side with states claiming gambling authority over prediction markets, firms in the sector will be forced to move overseas. The comments came as courts remain split over whether the CFTC or state regulators should oversee event contracts. item.title: CFTC proposes classifying prediction market event contracts as swaps while excluding sportsbook wagers — Oct 14, 2026 · 1:00 PM ET
item.description: - **CFTC proposes classifying prediction market event contracts as swaps while excluding sportsbook wagers** — The CFTC has proposed a rule defining event contracts on sports, politics, culture and weather as swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act, paired with an interim rule excluding casino games and traditional sportsbook wagers from that definition. Both actions are subject to a 30-day public comment period. ([Virlan](https://www.virlan.co/igaming/cftc-proposes-rules-classifying-prediction-market-event-contracts-as-swaps-while-excluding-sportsbooks/))

item.title: NFL tells Supreme Court sports prediction contracts are gambling, not swaps — Oct 14, 2026 · 1:00 PM ET
item.description: - **NFL tells Supreme Court sports prediction contracts are gambling, not swaps** — The NFL filed an amicus brief urging the Supreme Court to hear New Jersey's case against Kalshi, arguing that sports contracts on prediction markets are gambling rather than CFTC-regulated swaps. The league cited game integrity and consumer protection concerns, including trading tied to NFL games. ([The Block](https://www.theblock.co/news/regulation/2026-10-08-nfl-amicus-brief-supreme-court-kalshi-new-jersey-prediction-markets-418064))

item.description: - **Kalshi and Polymarket prepare perpetual futures markets for U.S. traders** — Kalshi and Polymarket are preparing perpetual futures products that would let U.S. traders hold leveraged positions without a fixed settlement date, with sample interfaces showing crypto, metals and stock contracts at up to 10 times leverage. The launch follows CFTC approval for Kalshi affiliate Kinetic Markets to offer margin trading as a futures commission merchant. ([Deadspin](https://deadspin.com/prediction-markets/legal-news/perpetual-futures-markets-coming-soon-to-kalshi-polymarket/))
